summary: The v1 semantic/key/identity findings are reusable because v2 changes only feedback. The v1 diagnostic erratum identified 72 exact option-text echoes; v2 removes those echoes and supplies option-ID-specific explanations tied to the visible ownership, state, lifecycle, or representation facts. I read all 72 messages against their actual targeted wrong options; target mappings are valid and explanations identify a case boundary or failure. The repeated generic second constraint (“Preserve the scenario’s stated lifecycle, identity, or external-effect boundary.”) is an advisory solution-shaped prompt, but not a direct keyed-answer disclosure and did not make a second option defensible. Reason overlaps the first two Details fields in all 18 objects; the remaining error-correction, tradeoff, and transfer fields add material instruction, so this is recorded as redundancy rather than a blocker.
